notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Irenicus's Vile Duplication, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
